The '''Prehistoric Skull''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[the Mountain]]s, mining a [[Mining#Bone Node|Bone Node]], or defeating a [[Haunted Skull]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

Donating this item, along with the [[Prehistoric Scapula]] and [[Skeletal Hand]], will reward the player with the [[Sloth Skeleton|Sloth Skeleton L]] statue.

==Bone Mill==
The Prehistoric Skull can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]] or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]].

==Bundles==
Prehistoric Skull is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Prehistoric Skull is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Prehistoric Skull is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt004|link=Tailoring{{!}}Skull Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a white dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 of any combination of bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe.
